findings.text: the anchor states both arms run "every test file importing reckon._store, derived by AST rather than by grep", but tests/test_read_plan_section_view.py imports the module directly at its line 12 and carries the identical blob 30679150f0cf96db09b827e28561529f28e0c2ac at both adfc6715 and e4be85c9, yet it is absent from gate-targets.json and from both arm logs, so the cohort's stated scope cannot be re-derived and the delta gate never covered that importer; my re-run of it at the reviewed head is 5 passed, so the exclusion did not change the recorded delta, but the claim is broader than the measurement.

the control paragraph presents the run's "11 failed, 41 deselected" as refusal cases failing with "Failed: DID NOT RAISE OpError", but 10 of those failures carry that text and the eleventh — tests/test_section_contract_is_refused.py:386, the write case — fails on its own record assertion (AssertionError: assert [] == [...], negative-control.log:366-373), so a reader counting the log against the prose finds one case unaccounted for.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base adfc6715 — e4be85c9 adds the shared _new_section_record helper at reckon/_store.py:992, extracts the authored-field checks and the queue call so the append target and the op share them, and rewrites _apply_insert_section at :2123 to register the record and its declaration beside the queued h2, with 11 new cases in the in-scope test file; 3d7afe48 is purely additive documentation (146 insertions, 0 deletions: plan prose, the evidence anchor section and creation-routes.svg), and the only deletions in the range are the 43 lines of that refactor inside reckon/_store.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the fence's measure asks for an insert_section refusal case and success case through the store boundary, an executed and logged negative control, the in-scope file and every _store importer passing by delta, and a landing record appended to the plan's section 2 — the cases are tests/test_section_contract_is_refused.py:327, :376, :386 and :403 (52 passed at head against 41 at base in my run), negative-control.log:1 repeats the declared string verbatim, the delta runs a 78-file cohort whose arm logs name revision, tree, command and module.__file__ (baseline.log:1, after.log:1) and is recorded as blocked with six added failures in tests/test_edit_plan_section_writes.py, and the plan prose and the evidence anchor section insert-section-typed-record are appended; the cohort clause is narrower than the record states — see the finding on docs/evidence/archive/section-contract-and-computed-impl-landed.html:575.
item_verdicts.goal: read the goal ("The insert_section edit_plan op refuses a new numbered section without its typed record, as the append and text paths already do") against the head's reckon/_store.py:2123 _apply_insert_section, which now requires the authored fields, validates the same SectionRecord the append target uses through the shared helper _new_section_record at reckon/_store.py:992, and refuses with the field named plus the worked example before anything is queued; my own re-run of the gate's named file in the reviewed worktree is 52 passed, and the prior review's finding that this route could still create a record-less section (r-20260925T035550325744-a-section-without-its-contract-is-refused.json, FINDING reckon/_store.py:2090) is closed at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; status blocked with the six added failure ids named and attributed to a file outside its fence, both commits listed, every named log and receipt resolving on disk, and each figure I re-read matching its source (52/41 from my own run, 78 targets in gate-targets.json, 5 to 10 failed and 2750/2756 passed from baseline.log and after.log).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared fence is reckon/_store.py, tests/test_section_contract_is_refused.py, docs/plans/section-contract-and-computed-impl.html, docs/evidence/archive/section-contract-and-computed-impl-landed.html and docs/figures/section-contract-and-computed-impl; git diff --numstat adfc6715..3d7afe48 names exactly those five (reckon/_store.py 62/43, the test file 96/0, the plan 30/0, the anchor 80/0, the figure SVG 36/0) and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_section_contract_is_refused.py:386 asserts the record, declaration, heading, body and ordering the op writes and is among the 11 cases that redden under the declared mutation in negative-control.log, so the registration is protected by an assertion that has been shown to fail.
justifications.evidence: every number in the manifest reproduces against baseline.log, after.log, failure-delta.json and gate-targets.json, but the cohort is described at docs/evidence/archive/section-contract-and-computed-impl-landed.html:575 as "every test file importing reckon._store, derived by AST" while an AST importer present at both revisions is absent from the target list, and the control paragraph at :562 counts a non-refusal failure into its DID NOT RAISE tally.
justifications.fit: the new helper follows the lazy-import, one-line-docstring idiom of the surrounding reckon/_store.py:992 helpers, the refusal reuses the existing _section_contract_refusal worked example, and both commits are two-part conventional messages with no ticket, plan label, version suffix or attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:2123-2136 validates the record through the shared helper and refuses before any queue call, and the executed control shows the refusal case reddens when that block is removed, so the op carries the same contract the append target does.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat adfc6715..3d7afe48 lists only the five declared paths, the two documentation files are additive with no plan-meta, status or version line touched, and the only test file changed is the one the fence names.
